metadata.title: Multicomplexes in Action: Strong Formality of Compact Hyperkähler Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We show that all compact hyperkähler manifolds are bigraded strongly formal in the sense of Milivojević and Stelzig, proving that in the context of pluripotential homotopy theory they play the same role as compact Kähler manifolds in rational homotopy theory. Indeed, the main result arises from general algebraic considerations on categories of objects with more differentials, that of multicomplexes and commutative $n$-differential graded algebras. For them we discuss a standard model category structure, introduce a generalization of the $\partial\bar{\partial}$-Lemma and establish an algebraic formality theorem.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 紧超 Kähler 流形的强形式性
analysis.workSummary: 证明所有紧超 Kähler 流形在 Milivojević–Stelzig 意义下具有双分次强形式性，使其在 pluripotential 同伦理论中扮演紧 Kähler 流形在有理同伦理论中的类似角色。由多重复形与交换 n-微分分次代数的模型范畴结构、广义 ∂∂̄ 引理及代数形式性定理推出。
techniques: 多重复形与交换多微分分次代数
analysis.breakthrough: 把特殊全纯辛几何的强形式性纳入可推广的多微分代数机制。
analysis.limitations: 紧性及超 Kähler 条件不可省略；双分次强形式性是指定同伦框架中的性质，不应与任意复流形的普通形式性混同。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
